name: lazybird
description: Text-to-speech for AI agents: turn text or SSML into MP3 voiceovers with 500+ voices in 150+ locales, clone a voice from a sample, or design one from a description. Lazybird Speech API.

interface.longDescription:
Lazybird turns text or SSML into natural MP3 speech through the Lazybird Speech API. The skill teaches the model the whole workflow: get an API key by email code, search 500+ voices in 150+ locales (built-in, community and your own cloned voices), generate voiceovers and narration with speed, pitch, volume and speaking-style settings, split long scripts into chunks, clone a voice from a short audio sample, and design a new voice from a text description.

Good for developers adding TTS to apps, scripts and agents, and for creators who need voiceovers, narration, audiobook drafts or podcast intros.

Limitations: you need a Lazybird account and API key. Output is MP3 only. SSML is limited to break and IPA phoneme tags. Only clone voices you have the right to use.
capabilities: Generate speech from text or SSML
Clone a voice from a sample
Design a voice from a description
defaultPrompt: Turn this paragraph into an MP3 voiceover with a warm US English female voice.
Find a deep British male narrator voice and generate a 20-second sample.
Add Lazybird text-to-speech to my Node.js app.

publication.release_notes: Voice cloning consent (rightsConfirmed) and Acceptable Use Policy link; voice design, long-script chunking, voice search recipes and an error-handling guide.
